playbookOutputs: 25–35 Page Bankable Business Plan (SEFA / IDC / NYDA / Commercial Bank Compliant) in PDF & Word
3–5 Year Integrated Financial Model (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Break-Even & Loan Amortization)
playbookCommonFailures: Funding amount requested does not reconcile to the supplier quotations and working capital breakdown
Projected debt-service coverage ratio (DSCR) falls below 1.25x under realistic revenue assumptions

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CIPC CoR 14.3)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the CIPC CoR 14.3 registration certificate of the applicant business.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 showing the registered enterprise name, registration number, and directors.

informationToProvide.label: Business Concept, Target Market, Target Funder (Bank / SEFA / IDC / NYDA) & Exact Funding Amount + Use of Funds Breakdown
informationToProvide.helpText: Detail what your business does, your target customers/off-take agreements, which funding institution you are applying to, the exact funding amount needed, and how the funds will be allocated (e.g., equipment, working capital, stock, vehicles).

informationToProvide.label: Revenue / Pricing Model & Expected Monthly Operating Overhead Costs
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide your product/service unit prices, expected monthly sales volumes, gross margin estimates, and monthly fixed expenses (rent, salaries, marketing, transport) to build your 3–5 year financial forecast.

informationToProvide.label: CVs / Resumes & Certified ID Copies of All Directors / Key Founders
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the CVs/resumes and ID copies of the directors and key management team.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Curriculum Vitae (CV) / resume and identification documents of the company directors and founders detailing qualifications and industry track record.

informationToProvide.label: Supplier Quotations / Pro-Forma Invoices for Equipment, Vehicles or Stock to be Financed
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload formal supplier quotations for any machinery, vehicles, or inventory to be purchased with the funding.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Supplier pro-forma invoices or quotations supporting the capital expenditure schedule in the business plan.

informationToProvide.label: Latest Annual Financial Statements or 6 Months Bank Statements (If Business Is Already Trading)
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: Is the business already actively trading?
informationToProvide.helpText: If the business is already trading, upload your latest financial statements or 6 months bank statements to anchor historical performance.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Historical Annual Financial Statements, management accounts, or 6 months business bank statements of the applicant company.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Review funding questionnaire & business drivers
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Revenue models, cost assumptions, and capex items confirmed

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Build 3-year financial model and forecast
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: 3-year P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow projections completed

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft full narrative business plan document
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Executive summary, market analysis, operations, and financials merged

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver Word & PDF business plan pack to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Delivered to client with review session support

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms quality and signs off
